name: Synthetic dynamic fixture baseline
description: Deterministic authored metadata for dynamic WCAG fixture scenarios covering controlled failures and passes.

scenarios.task_description: Open the dialog and traverse focus using Tab until focus should leave the widget.
scripted_steps: Press Tab five times and record focus_sequence and keyboard_events.

expected_evidence: focus_sequence repeats the same dialog control after multiple Tab key events
keyboard_events contains repeated Tab traversal attempts

scenarios.task_description: Tab through controls and verify whether each focused element has a visible focus indicator.
scripted_steps: Press Tab through all visible controls.
Capture focus_visible_trace and screenshot_paths for each focused control.

expected_evidence: focus_visible_trace has has_visible_indicator=false for the active button
screenshot_paths include the focused state with no visible indicator

scenarios.task_description: Tab through a checkout form and compare focus movement with the visual and DOM task order.
scripted_steps: Press Tab from the first form field through the submit button.

expected_evidence: focus_sequence moves from shipping name to submit before required address fields
step order does not preserve the meaningful task sequence

scenarios.task_description: Open a modal dialog and verify focus remains inside the active modal content.
scripted_steps: Press Tab until focus reaches content behind the modal.

expected_evidence: focus_sequence includes a background page link while the modal remains open
the focused target is outside the active dialog subtree

scenarios.task_description: Reveal tooltip content with hover and focus and verify dismissibility, hoverability, and persistence.
scripted_steps: Move the pointer onto the revealed content and press Escape.
Focus the help icon with Tab and record hover_focus_revealed_content.

expected_evidence: hover_focus_revealed_content shows content appears only on hover
has_dismiss_control is false for the revealed content

scenarios.task_description: Submit a form that injects a success message and verify status announcement semantics.
scripted_steps: Record status_message_mutations and live_region_presence after the success message appears.

expected_evidence: status_message_mutations contains the inserted success text
live_region_presence is false for the injected message container

scenarios.task_description: Start an inactivity timeout and verify whether the user receives a warning or extension control.
scripted_steps: Wait for the configured timeout threshold.

expected_evidence: timing_snapshots shows an inactivity deadline
timeout_warnings remains empty before the session-ending transition

scenarios.task_description: Submit an invalid form and verify that error identification is visible and announced.
scripted_steps: Submit the form with required fields empty.
Record form_snapshots, error_messages, status_message_mutations, and focus_sequence.

expected_evidence: form_snapshots shows an invalid submitted form
error_messages contains a visual error but no associated field reference or announcement evidence

scenarios.task_description: Trigger a flashing alert and record animation and flash evidence.

expected_evidence: flash_events contains an observed strobe/flicker signal
the fixture is authored above the safe flashing threshold

scenarios.task_description: Use a custom pointer-only button and verify whether the operation can be cancelled before completion.
scripted_steps: Trigger pointerdown on the custom control.

expected_evidence: pointer_handlers contains an onpointerdown activation target
pointer_cancellation_indicators is empty for the target

scenarios.task_description: Move an item in a drag-only list and verify whether a single-pointer or keyboard alternative exists.
scripted_steps: Start a drag interaction on a list item.
Record dragging_indicators and any keyboard alternative indicators.

expected_evidence: dragging_indicators contains a draggable target
the fixture has no keyboard alternative for the dragging movement

scenarios.task_description: Play a prerecorded video and verify caption track availability.

expected_evidence: media_elements contains an audible prerecorded video
caption_tracks is empty

scenarios.task_description: Tab through ordinary controls and verify focus progresses with the keyboard.

expected_evidence: keyboard_events contains Tab traversal
focus_sequence advances through multiple controls

scenarios.task_description: Tab to the primary action and verify the focused state has a visible outline.
scripted_steps: Press Tab to the primary action.

expected_evidence: focus_visible_trace has has_visible_indicator=true
screenshot_paths contains the focused control state

scenarios.task_description: Tab through a form and verify focus follows the meaningful form sequence.
scripted_steps: Press Tab through all form controls.

expected_evidence: focus_sequence advances from first input to second input to submit
the order matches the authored task sequence

scenarios.task_description: Reveal a popover from hover and focus and verify a dismiss control is available.

expected_evidence: hover_focus_revealed_content is present
has_dismiss_control is true for the revealed content

scenarios.task_description: Submit a form that inserts a status message into a live region.

expected_evidence: status_message_mutations contains the inserted status text
live_region_presence is true

scenarios.task_description: Start an inactivity timer and verify warning plus extension controls are available.
scripted_steps: Wait until the timeout warning appears.

expected_evidence: timing_snapshots contains a deadline with user_extend_control=true
timeout_warnings contains an extend-session warning

scenarios.task_description: Trigger a below-threshold flashing indicator and verify it is marked safe.

expected_evidence: flash_events contains below_threshold=true
the authored flash rate is within the safe threshold

scenarios.task_description: Use a pointer control that activates on pointerup and supports cancellation.
scripted_steps: Trigger pointerdown and pointerup on the custom control.

expected_evidence: pointer_handlers contains the pointer control
pointer_cancellation_indicators contains pointerup/cancel evidence

scenarios.task_description: Move an item with drag and verify keyboard alternative controls are present.
scripted_steps: Inspect draggable list items and keyboard move buttons.

expected_evidence: dragging_indicators contains draggable targets
each dragging indicator has has_keyboard_alternative=true

scenarios.task_description: Play a prerecorded video and verify caption tracks are present.

expected_evidence: media_elements contains an audible prerecorded video
caption_tracks contains a captions track
